chunks: And your Lord knows what they hide in their breasts and what they disclose.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God knowing what is hidden in the heart?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights Allah's comprehensive knowledge (Ilm) that encompasses both the manifest (Zahir) and the hidden (Batin) of the human soul, serving as a comfort to the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) regarding the concealed hostility of the disbelievers. It underscores the divine attribute of being All-Knowing (Al-Alim) and All--Seeing (Al-Basir), reinforcing the concept that no secret remains hidden from the Divine Presence.
